title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together flour, baking soda, and salt.
In a large bowl, beat butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until creamy.
Add vanilla and eggs to the butter mixture; beat well.
Gradually mix in the flour mixture.
Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets.
Bake 9-11 minutes until golden brown. Cool on baking sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to a wire rack.
notes: For chewier cookies, slightly underbake and let them finish cooking on the hot pan.

title: Tomato Basil Pasta
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, red pepper flakes, and salt. Simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Drain pasta and toss with the sauce.
Stir in fresh basil and top with parmesan cheese before serving.

title: Creamy Garlic Mushroom Chicken

ingredients.item: red pepper flakes, as many as you like
onions, diced (optional, in addition to the onions below)
chicken breast, cut into small cubes
cooking cream (or twice as much coconut milk/cream)
jalapeños, chopped (at least) — swap for bell pepper, or omit for less heat
butter or ghee, for the pan
cashews or walnuts, for the rice
kewpie mayo mixed with truffle mayo, as a fry sauce (optional)

instructions.text: Combine the curry powder, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, turmeric, black pepper, salt, a generous amount of olive oil, and pepper flakes to taste. Stir in diced onions if using.
Toss the chicken cubes in the marinade to coat.
Heat a pan over medium heat. Add the chicken only once the pan is sizzling — if it's not hot enough yet, take the chicken back out and wait. Don't let the pan get too hot either.

Cook 2-4 minutes per side depending on thickness, flipping each piece individually so none are missed, and being careful not to overcook. Work in multiple batches if the pan isn't big enough — don't stack the chicken.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
In the same pan over the same heat, add butter or ghee. Add the whole garlic cloves and cook about a minute on each side.
Add the onions, chopped mushrooms, diced garlic, and jalapeños (if using). If you forgot the whole garlic cloves earlier, add them in now too.
Stir in the Dijon mustard, soy sauce, flour, and steak sauce if using. Let simmer 2-3 minutes per side for a little browning.
Return the chicken to the pan, then add the broth cubes mixed with about 1 glass (250-300ml) of water, plus the cooking cream (or coconut milk).
Mix well and simmer 10-20 minutes — the longer it simmers, the thicker and creamier it gets. Periodically check the bottom of the pan for sticking or burning; turn off the heat if it starts to catch.
Serve in separate bowls next to fries and rice topped with nuts, raisins, and/or pickles, plus a drink.
For the fries, try a kewpie mayo and truffle mayo mix as a dipping sauce.

notes: Makes about 10 medium servings or 6 large ones.
